step_by_step_reasoning: First, the generic 'AWS' node from the visual World Model has been expanded based on the audio transcript into its specific constituents: S3 Logs, SNS, SQS, CloudTrail, and GuardDuty. Apache NiFi is added as the workflow/ingestion tool mentioned that pulls these telemetry events. Next, the on-premise infrastructure is preserved as a ThirdParty node. These feeds flow into Apache Metron for real-time parsing, enrichment, and profiling. For long-term data storage, a serverless Security Data Lake is configured where an EMR job picks up data from Metron's HDFS layer, transforms it, and writes it to an S3 Data Lake bucket. Athena is used to query S3, building analytical models that are fed back into Apache Metron. Finally, security alerts trigger the SOAR (Blitz) platform, displaying alerts to the SOC Analyst, who can block threats by executing controls on AWS WAF.
